_readme: The kie.ai model catalog + routing map, trimmed to the models actually used. This is the single source of truth the 'director' (Claude) reads to pick a model and fill params, and that the adapter reads to build the actual HTTP request. Update this file when you add/change models — nothing else needs to change.

auth.note: Key is read from the KIE_API_KEY env var (server-side) or per-user BYOK storage. NEVER commit a key.

jobs.note: All five models below use this one unified async endpoint. Response returns a taskId; poll until state is success (result urls) or fail.

api.flow: 1) POST createTask -> get taskId.  2) Poll recordInfo every ~3-5s until state == success or fail.  3) Return media url(s).

_confidence: Model `id` strings are CONFIRMED from docs.kie.ai (Nov 2025+ catalog). The exact `input` field names are best-effort from kie's unified Jobs API convention and should be confirmed against each model's docs page on first live integration — the shape is right, a field name may need a tweak. Flagged per-model via `input_verified`.

models.label: GPT Image 2
models.use_when: Best for complex, multi-element compositions, precise instruction-following, clean edits, and sharp legible text / polished product photography. When reference/edit images are supplied, the adapter swaps the model id to `gpt-image-2-image-to-image`.

image_urls.note: Source/reference images -> triggers the image-to-image id.

models.label: Nano Banana Pro
models.use_when: High-fidelity Gemini 3 Pro image model, up to 4K, excellent at readable text/logos/diagrams and crisp realism. Great default when GPT Image 2 isn't specifically needed — fast and strong on product/marketing shots and reference-based edits.

models.label: Kling 3.0
models.use_when: Cinematic video from text or a start image, multi-shot storytelling, native audio, 3-15s. Strong general-purpose default with the most cinematic camera control.

image_urls.note: Start/last frame image(s); when set, aspect_ratio is auto-matched.

models.label: Gemini Omni
models.use_when: Google's Gemini Omni video model — high-quality generation and conversational editing from text, image, and/or video inputs. Use for polished results and when you want to edit/extend an existing clip via follow-up instructions.

models.label: Seedance 2.0
models.use_when: ByteDance multimodal video model tuned for fast, realistic generation and strong subject/identity consistency in motion. Use when you want speed + realism, or to preserve a character's look across the clip.
